lines.text: By the way, the party starts at seven.

data.define: Used to add a new, related thought in a talk.

example.text: By the way, the party starts at seven.

misuse.text: Don't use 'by the way' for your main point.
misuse.why: It signals a minor, extra comment.

data.l1_ex: By the way, tiệc bắt đầu lúc bảy giờ nha.

native.tip: “by the way” = Nhân tiện. Ví dụ: “By the way, the party starts at seven.”
native.caption:
“by the way” nghĩa là gì?
“by the way” = Nhân tiện.
Ví dụ: “By the way, the party starts at seven.” (By the way, tiệc bắt đầu lúc bảy giờ nha.)
